audit: Region-stratified nonlinear mutual-information screen for S1-S5; diagnostic only, no feature integration

method.scope: Every registered S1-S5 emission versus every emission from a different currently implemented idea, including cross-pairs among S1-S5; same-idea emission pairs are excluded. Each unordered feature pair is evaluated once per official region.
method.continuous_encoding: Within each region, use deterministic empirical deciles (NumPy linear quantiles at 0.1 through 0.9; ties may collapse bins); bins are computed from that feature's region-defined values before pairwise masking.
method.categorical_encoding: Keep integer-valued features with at most 10 distinct region-defined values as categories; this retains binary/flag features as categories. Other features use empirical-decile bins.
method.pairwise_mask: Only rows with both emissions defined and finite are included; calculate NMI when joint count >=30.
method.nmi: Symmetric arithmetic normalization: 2*MI/(H(X)+H(Y)) using natural-log entropy; if either/both encodings have zero entropy, report NMI=0 as non-informative. Numerical results are clipped only for floating-point roundoff into [0,1].

interpretation: Diagnostic NMI flags are for reviewer decisions only; no registered estimator or frozen feature was changed.

pair_measurements.feature_indexes: See feature_catalog; region_index refers to region_catalog.
